title: MPPSC Assistant Professor Recruitment 2025 Result / Cutoff 2026
vacancyDetails: Subject-wise vacancies: Sanskrit 34; Geography 74; Psychology 10; Law 17; Geology 10; Yogic Science 03.
qualification: Master's degree in the relevant subject with at least 55% marks, and UGC / CSIR NET / SLET / SET qualification as applicable. Read the subject-wise eligibility in the official MPPSC assistant professor notification.
ageLimit: Minimum age: 21 years; Maximum age: 40 years as on 01/01/2026. Category-wise relaxation is applicable as per MPPSC rules.
applicationFee: General / Other State: ₹500/-; SC / ST / OBC / EWS / PH: ₹250/-; Portal Charges: ₹60/-; Correction Charges: ₹50/-. Fee payment through debit card, credit card, net banking and other online fee modes only.
selectionProcess: Written Examination / Screening → Subject-wise Result / Cutoff Announcement → Document Verification / Interview as per notification → Final Selection
documentsRequired: Registration details, roll number, photo ID, educational certificates, UGC / CSIR NET / SLET / SET proof where applicable, category certificate, and any documents required for subject-wise verification.
howToApply:
1. Visit the official MPPSC portal at https://mppsc.mp.gov.in/
2. Open the MPPSC Assistant Professor recruitment section
3. Download the result / cutoff and subject-wise notice if available
4. Check roll number / category-wise result or merit list
5. Follow further document verification or interview instructions issued by MPPSC
shortDescription: MPPSC Assistant Professor Recruitment 2025 Result / Cutoff 2026 has been declared subject-wise on 11 September 2026. Check the result and subject-wise cutoff from the official MPPSC portal.
content:
Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission (MPPSC) has released the Assistant Professor Recruitment 2025/2026 Result / Cutoff update.

The MPPSC Assistant Professor recruitment notice was issued for 148 vacancies and the subject-wise result has been published on 11 September 2026.

Important Dates

  • Application Start: 25/05/2026
  • Last Date: 26/06/2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date: 26/06/2026
  • Correction Date: 30 May / 28 June 2026
  • Exam Date: 02/08/2026
  • Admit Card Available: 29/07/2026
  • Result Declared: 11/09/2026 Subject-wise

Subject-wise vacancy summary

  • Sanskrit: 34
  • Geography: 74
  • Psychology: 10
  • Law: 17
  • Geology: 10
  • Yogic Science: 03

Candidates should open the official MPPSC result and cutoff pages, verify their roll number, and follow any subject-wise document verification, interview, or next-stage instructions issued by MPPSC.
